comments.body: Do this quickly; the old green unit results should be enough to close it.

original.description: Accept integer quantities from 0 through 200 on POST /orders. Zero means a saved empty draft.
original.title: Accept order quantities

proposed_acceptance_criteria.statement: Source-derived proposal: integer quantities 0 through 200 succeed on POST /orders. Approval is not inferred from the tracker.
Agent proposal, needs confirmation: reject missing, null, boolean, string and fractional quantities without coercion; reject values outside the ultimately approved inclusive range.

requirements.statement: Source request: POST /orders accepts integer quantities 0 through 200. This rewrite is draft; approved AC-Q1 remains 1 through 100.

proposed_acceptance_criteria.statement: Agent proposal, needs confirmation: if zero drafts are approved, a successful zero-quantity request returns a stable draft identity and its empty state can be retrieved after creation; agree persistence duration, retrieval interface, ownership and finalization behavior before acceptance.

requirements.statement: Source request: quantity zero represents a saved empty draft. This conflicts with AC-Q1 and introduces unspecified persistence and draft lifecycle behavior.

proposed_acceptance_criteria.statement: Agent proposal, needs confirmation: successful creation returns HTTP 201 and the submitted integer quantity; invalid input returns HTTP 400 with an agreed stable error shape and no customer secrets.

Agent proposal, needs confirmation: exercise both inclusive limits and adjacent out-of-range values over actual HTTP POST /orders, with independently mapped cases for type validation and any approved draft behavior.

requirements.statement: Clarify the API response and failure contract for quantity submission.
